To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the expression of hsp 71 is increased in the brains of mice after the administration of the drug geldanamycin, and that the increase in hsp 71 expression is due to an increase in hsp71 mRNA levels.
GA infusion into the lateral ventricles of the mouse brain led the induction of HSP70 genes in the hippocampus and the cortex.
GA infusion into the brain of hsp 1 knockout mice resulted in a marked up-regulation of the hsp 1 gene, and that this up-regulation was not observed in the hsp 70 knockout mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of GA on the mouse brain.
the effects of geldanamycine in the brain of mice.
identifying the genes that are induced by GA and the role of these genes in the neurotoxicity of the drug.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the up-regulation by GA of hsp 72 in the brain is due to a combination of the effects on the transcription of hsp 71 and hsp 72 and on the stability of hsp 73 mRNA.
the up-regulation in the mouse brain of hsp 71.1 after GA administration may be related to the neurotoxic effects of GA, and that this up-regulation is not related to hsp 70 expression in the brain.
the up-regulation in the brain of hsp 71 and hsp 72 is a consequence of GA treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
hsp 70 mRNA is differentially expressed in the mouse brain following GA administration.
the HSP70 gene family is differentially expressed in response to GA in the mouse brain.
the hsp 70 gene is induced by GA in the mouse brain.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hsp 70 isoforms are up-regulated in different regions of the brain in response to GA administration.
GA is a useful tool for studying the role of specific HSPs in the brain.
hsp 70 mRNA levels are differentially regulated in the mouse brain in response to GA.
